title: CROSSFILTER BOTH gives the same result with the one-side column first
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( Customer ), Product[Color] = "Blue", CROSSFILTER ( Customer[CustomerKey], Sales[CustomerKey], BOTH ) ) )

source.quote: The order of the two column arguments is not important for None, OneWay, and Both
source.supports: for BOTH the order of the two columns does not matter

derivation: Blue is product 3: Sales rows 4 and 6, customers 2 and 3. With both directions on Sales[CustomerKey] -> Customer[CustomerKey], Customer is filtered to those 2 rows.
